title: 2026 UK ETS Cost Containment Mechanism intervention options QA

sources.title: Taking part in the UK Emissions Trading Scheme markets

facts.source_fact: The Cost Containment Mechanism provides a means for Authority intervention when prices are elevated for a sustained period.
A CCM trigger does not automatically dictate a specific intervention.
The Authority considers whether intervention is warranted based on sustained price movements and market fundamentals.
If Authority members cannot agree on action, the final decision is taken by HM Treasury.
Potential intervention can redistribute allowances between auctions in the current year.
Potential intervention can bring forward auction allowances from future years.
Potential intervention can draw allowances from the market stability mechanism account.
Potential intervention can auction up to 25% of remaining allowances in the New Entrants Reserve.
The Authority has retained the existing price-based CCM design rather than adopting a quantity-triggered standalone supply adjustment mechanism.
CCM trigger information is updated monthly by the Authority.
